description: This file defines a Dart class 'NewsApiClient' responsible for fetching news articles from an external API ('newsapi.org'). It includes functionality for constructing HTTP requests, handling API responses, and parsing JSON data into NewsArticle objects. It also defines an exception class 'NewsApiException' to handle API-related errors.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to News API interactions.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class for fetching news data from an external news API, with methods to retrieve top headlines and handle HTTP communication.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches top news headlines for a specified country and optional category, handling API request, response, and JSON parsing.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client connection.
